card.name: Unit words after a quantity number
card.fires_on: The unit word (units, cup, mmole) right after a number in a dose, serving size or amount. It is strongest for "units" after numbers such as million or 10.

modes.label: Units after dose number
modes.description: The word units or Units directly after a number in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: 12 to 24 million<< units>>/day depending on the infection and its severity

modes.label: Serving size in food tables
modes.description: The word cup after a fraction or number in a nutrient table of cooked foods.

modes.label: Partial unit word
modes.description: The middle of mmole after a number in a recommended amount.
modes.example: the recommended dosage is 1 mm<<ole>> of L-cysteine hydrochlor
